_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows tactica.'s Case File card to the user. Don't repeat its numbers; reply with one or two sentences of insight.

description: Paid (1.00 USDC per call); free alternatives: the Match of the Round forecast. For "why?", "preview this match" or the likely score of one Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2 match. Pass team names directly (match: "Forest v Chelsea"); no need to call list_fixtures first. The tactica. Case File for one fixture: the forecast, the score grid, what drove the forecast, an evidence summary and the predicted line-ups. The revision history and bulk evidence come only with include. Use this when you need the reasoning or score-level detail. Use get_match_forecast instead for the headline chances only (cheaper), or get_betting_picks for recommended bets. Read-only; the latest.

away.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the away team. Example: Chelsea

detail.description: Optional. full returns every number as data, even when the app shows a tactica. card. Example: full

fixtureId.description: Optional: the tactica. fixture id, from list_fixtures; or pass the teams instead (home + away, or match). Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

home.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the home team as people say it. Example: Forest

include.description: Optional. history and/or evidence, comma separated: adds the forecast revision history and/or the bulk evidence rows, which are left out by default to keep the Case File small. No extra charge. Example: history

match.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the match in words; the next meeting is used. Example: Forest v Chelsea

team.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: one team; its next fixture is used. Example: Arsenal

name: get_case_file
title: Get a match Case File
